source.title: FCH2Rail D6.1 Report on KPI assessment
source.rights_boundary: Public report access is verified; the report does not release synchronized raw logger rows or derived-metric reuse terms.

experiment.facility: Transportable FCH2Rail HRS and demonstrator train
experiment.vehicle_storage: Two independent 80 kg, 350 bar modules; each module has sixteen 205 L Type-III cylinders
experiment.supply_boundary: 300 bar tube-trailer storage, no chiller, 10 m hose

claim_boundary: This public report supplies independently reported operating-range and topology context for a transportable HRS refuelling a large vehicle. It supports face-validity checks for the simulator's flow-rate and trailer-supply ranges, but the absence of synchronized raw station/vehicle rows, controller states, calibration metadata and reuse terms prevents numerical full-loop validation or a SAGA effectiveness claim.
